name: ACCESS_DEVICE_EVENT_RISK_REASON_TYPE
description: This is the technical response code that was returned to the merchant regarding the risk of approving this transaction. This may be triggered by a rule in the authorization engine.

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_RISK_FACTOR_ROLE
description: Code indicating the role of analytical model with respect to the risk factor, for example, a consumer, or producer.

name: APPLICATION_INSURANCE_RISK_CATEGORY
description: This associative entity tracks the combination of an application and risk category over time.

name: ASSET_CLASS_MATURITY_RISK_GRADE

name: ASSET_INSURANCE_RISK_CATEGORY
description: The association of a risk category to a customer asset.

name: ASSET_INSURANCE_RISK_FACTOR
description: This associative entity relates the asset with any risk factors, such as airbags, sprinkler system, and theft alarm.

name: ASSET_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity contains a history of the risk grades for this customer asset item.

name: ASSET_RISK_GRADE_RELATED
description: This entity relates one risk grade assessment to another risk grade assessment to identify when one risk assessment replaces or overrides another risk assessment for an asset. description: This summary entity tracks available capital metrics for the bank or one of its subsidiaries over time. description: This entity lists the risk weights to be applied to equity exposures. The risk-weights are as defined by the Basel Accord.

description: This offers a second means of classifying the exposure item such as expense or loss.
